2026-2027.summary: National Broadway League data for the week of August 23, 2026 reveals divergent touring momentum: Hell's Kitchen experienced a sharp 62% gross decline with paid capacity plummeting from 95% to 51%, signaling potential demand softening or tour scheduling gaps, while The Outsiders surged 41% in gross and sold to 97% capacity, and The Great Gatsby posted 17% growth. These mixed signals suggest selective strength in the touring market rather than broad-based demand trends.
